summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories (hubs where models are published, versioned, and distributed) and developer-facing inference platforms (APIs that serve those models at scale). Hugging Face dominates as the central hub, crossing 3 million public models in August 2026, though roughly half of all models have fewer than 200 downloads and the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads. Platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow build on this open ecosystem by offering local execution or hosted, pay-per-use inference optimized for speed, cost, and ease of integration.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The largest open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus hosted inference endpoints and serverless inference APIs.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3M in August 2026, growing by ~1M per year)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and limited inference; Pro subscription (~$9/month); pay-as-you-go Inference Endpoints (dedicated, priced by hardware/hour); Enterprise plans available.
features: Massive model, dataset, and Spaces repository
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Download stats and query-file-based download counting
platforms.best_for: Researchers, developers, and organizations seeking the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaborative tooling.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Tool for running open LLMs locally on your own hardware with a simple CLI and API, plus optional cloud hosting.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, and quantized variants)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source for local use; Ollama Cloud offers hosted/subscription tiers for running larger models remotely.
features: One-command local model download and execution
GGUF quantized models for consumer hardware
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run and prototype with LLMs locally without cloud dependencies.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform to run and deploy open-source models via API without managing infrastructure, with a focus on easy sharing of packaged models.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published models spanning text, image, video, and audio
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing) or per-request for some models; no base subscription required.
features: Run models via simple REST API
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Supports image/video generation, LLMs, and multimodal models
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting to integrate diverse open models (especially generative image/video) via API with minimal infrastructure work.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: Developer inference and fine-tuning cloud offering fast, scalable access to a large catalog of open-source LLMs and multimodal models.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (varies by model size); pay-per-use fine-tuning and dedicated GPU instances.
features: Supports chat, embeddings, image generation, and code models
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies needing production-grade, cost-efficient inference and fine-tuning for open models at scale.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance inference platform optimized for ultra-fast, low-latency serving of open LLMs and multimodal models in production.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom model deployment
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; on-demand and reserved dedicated GPU pricing; fine-tuning billed by usage.
features: Optimized FireAttention inference engine for speed
Low-latency serving for agentic and real-time apps
platforms.best_for: Production teams prioritizing inference speed, low latency, and cost efficiency for LLM-powered applications.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: Developer inference platform (strong in the Chinese and Asian markets) offering accelerated serving of open-source LLMs, image, and audio models.
platforms.model_count: Dozens to 100+ open models, including strong coverage of Chinese models like Qwen, DeepSeek, and GLM
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / pay-per-use inference, often with competitive low pricing and free quotas for select models.
features: Broad coverage of leading Chinese open models
Text, image, and audio generation support
Free tiers and promotional credits for popular models
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in China/Asia) seeking affordable inference access to leading open models including top Chinese LLMs.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: Inference platform built on custom LPU hardware delivering extremely high token-generation speeds for open LLMs.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, and others)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token inference with competitive rates; free developer tier available.
features: Industry-leading inference throughput and low latency
Optimized for real-time and agentic workloads
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive applications that demand the fastest possible token generation.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated across dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with pass-through provider pricing plus a small markup; credits-based billing.
features: Single API for many model providers
Price and performance comparison across providers
Access to both open and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to a wide range of models through one unified API.
